and.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.site_information si JOIN clinlims.localization l ON l.id = CASE WHEN BTRIM(COALESCE(si.value, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN BTRIM(si.value)::numeric END WHERE si.name = 'bannerHeading'

changeSet.comment: Apply the China product name to the localization record referenced by bannerHeading; never assume a seed ID.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.localization_value (id, localization_id, locale, value, last_updated) SELECT nextval('clinlims.localization_value_seq'), l.id, 'zh', '临床检验信息系统', now() FROM clinlims.site_information si JOIN clinlims.localization l ON l.id = CASE WHEN BTRIM(COALESCE(si.value, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN BTRIM(si.value)::numeric END WHERE si.name = 'bannerHeading' ON CONFLICT (localization_id, locale) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, last_updated = now()

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM clinlims.localization_value lv USING clinlims.site_information si WHERE si.name = 'bannerHeading' AND lv.localization_id = CASE WHEN BTRIM(COALESCE(si.value, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN BTRIM(si.value)::numeric END AND lv.locale = 'zh' AND lv.value = '临床检验信息系统'
